---
name: Hiring loop for backend engineers
description: The four interviews, what each one is for, and the rejection reasons that repeat
type: project
---

Four interviews: a screen, a systems design session, a code reading exercise and
a values conversation. The code reading exercise replaced the whiteboard puzzle
and correlates far better with the first ninety days on the job.

## The repeated rejection reason
The most common reason for a no is not weak code, it is a candidate who cannot
say why they chose one approach over another.
